Centre to launch AI-enabled free NEET-JEE coaching platform Oct 2

The Centre plans to launch a free, AI-enabled national platform for NEET and JEE coaching on October 2. This initiative aims to save students significant amounts of money on coaching fees. The platform is part of the NDA government's outreach to young voters.
